Initial release of Explainer Video Free – AI-powered explainer video creation from scripts or text input.

- Instantly creates animated explainer videos with voiceover and subtitles from your text/script in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports MP4, MOV, TXT, DOCX uploads up to 200MB; no installation required.
- Automated session setup and authentication with free tokens (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Cloud GPU rendering pipeline with 1080p export; progress and state updates reflected in chat.
- Intuitive text commands for uploading, previewing, exporting, and checking credits/balance.
- Responsive error handling and user guidance for file, format, and account issues.
